Name: (CP) Cypress Tree for Latteholn's Italian Town Buildings
Author: SingleMaltWhisky
Description:
This mod is meant to be used as an addition to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/222320112]Latteholn's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45720]Italian Town Buildings[/url].
Instead of only replacing the textures of the Maple and Pine Trees with a Cypress Tree texture this mod replaces them with an actual Cypress Tree. This tree will spawn in Pelican Town and the locations around it (Cindersap Forest, The Mountain, Busstop and the Backwoods) and will drop Cypress Seeds which you can plant on your farm. There's also Cypress Oil to be obtained when you put a Tapper on a Cypress Tree. 

[b]Note: Starting a new game is highly recommended, on existing saves the Maple and Pine Trees on the above mentioned locations will only be replaced after you chop them down. Then the Cyprus Tree will grow back in it's place. You can also use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37233]Clear Terrain Features[/url] for clearing and regrowing trees.[/b]

[size=5][b]Install instructions:[/b][/size]
[size=2]Just copy the folder from the .zip file into your mods folder. [/size]

[size=5][b]Todo:[/b][/size]
[size=2]- Add a use for Cypress Oil. Maybe a crafting recipe/cooking ingredient. Suggestions are welcome.[/size]

[size=5][b]Credits:[/b][/size]
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/222320112]Latteholn[/url] for the amazing Cypress Tree assets, from which I got permission to use these assets in my mod.
